Ballot Drop Box Locations

300 Ottawa Ave NW

Located across from Calder Plaza on the East side of Ottawa Ave.

Open in Google Maps

16 Elm Street SW

Located on the curb on the north side of the new Division Avenue Fire Station.

Open in Google Maps

1563 Plainfield Ave NE

Located curbside in front of the Van Belkum Library on Plainfield Ave.

Open in Google Maps

1017 Leonard St. NW

Located in the East parking lot of the West Leonard Library.

Open in Google Maps

1150 Giddings SE

Located curbside on Giddings, outside of the Ottawa Hills Library.

Open in Google Maps

2350 Eastern SE

Located on the rear of the Seymour Library building, by the book drop.

Open in Google Maps

110 Fountain NE

Located curbside across from the Main Library - next to the book drop.

Open in Google Maps

2025 Leonard NE

Located near the bike rack on the drive between the parking lots at the Yankee Clipper Library.

Open in Google Maps

713 Bridge NW

Located at the rear entrance of the Westside Library next to the book drop.

Open in Google Maps

1201 Madison SE

Located next to the entrance door of the Madison Square Library
